# the247

> A studio building SaaS platforms, automation engines, mobile apps and websites end-to-end with AI-assisted development. 14 shipped projects, 4 live domains, 4 automation engines, 1 store-ready mobile app.

the247 is a small studio run by three co-founders, currently doubling as a live portfolio of everything shipped so far. Design and code are produced end-to-end with AI tooling doing the heavy lifting on scaffolding, migrations and boilerplate — a human still scopes, reviews, and ships every release.

## Automation Engines & SaaS

- Palift Sales Workflow — bilingual (EN/AR) six-stage sales pipeline for a forklift/heavy-machinery dealer. React 19, Firebase, TypeScript, i18next. Status: live.
- AI Genesis — autonomous YouTube content factory (research, script, voice-over, video assembly, publishing). Python, Gemini API, Google TTS, YouTube API. Status: live.
- ROZ — Core HR — attendance & leave-management SaaS with cron-scheduled push reminders. Next.js, Prisma, PostgreSQL, NextAuth. Status: beta.
- LinkedIn Apply Agent — job-search automation tool (scrape, match, draft, report). Node.js, Puppeteer. Status: internal tool.

## Mobile

- Tasbih — digital dhikr/prayer-bead counter app, signed Android App Bundle with AdMob. React, Capacitor, Gemini API, AdMob. Status: store-ready.

## Marketplace & Platforms

- Zafaf HQ — Arabic-language wedding venue & vendor marketplace for Jordan (150+ venues). https://7mz410.github.io/ZafafHQ/ — Status: pre-launch.
- Madtape — watch-and-submit platform for short-form AI-generated films. https://madtape.com — Status: pre-launch.
- Meke Technical Supply — Hebrew-language landing page concept. Status: concept.
